topics.title: OpenAI reorganizes stand-alone robotics team into core research and product groups
topics.summary: On November 13, 2026, Fortune reported that OpenAI disbanded its stand-alone robotics unit, reassigning staff to Mark Chen's research group and Greg Brockman's applied division. OpenAI clarified that robotics work continues, arguing general-purpose frontier models can increasingly control physical robots directly without isolated robotics-only AI models.

topics.title: Ontario Court of Appeal lets Canadian news publishers' copyright lawsuit against OpenAI proceed
topics.summary: On November 13, 2026, the Ontario Court of Appeal dismissed an appeal by OpenAI, allowing a copyright lawsuit by a coalition of Canadian news organizations—including The Canadian Press, Torstar, and CBC/Radio-Canada—to move forward in Ontario courts over the alleged unlicensed use of journalism to train ChatGPT.

topics.title: Federal Reserve flags AI as top financial stability risk as data center debt tops $680 billion
topics.summary: In its November 13, 2026 Financial Stability Report, the U.S. Federal Reserve said 87% of surveyed market contacts cited AI as a top near-term financial stability risk, up from 50% in May. The report noted advanced computing debt issuance exceeded $680 billion through October 2026, roughly five times 2023 levels.
